responsibility: Declares the public helper interface exported from the tree SSA strlen optimization machinery. It exposes predicates and range helpers for strlen-related expressions, dynamic string-length range queries, truncation-diagnostic helpers, zero-equality use discovery, and the printf-call handler shared with the sprintf/format optimization and warning code.
same_name_distinction: This header exposes selected helper APIs from the strlen machinery—range queries, truncation diagnostics, zero-equality discovery, and printf handling—for other code to call. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-strlen.cc, it does not implement the dominator-walk string analysis pass itself.
